title: globalShortcut.isRegistered stays true after unregisterAll
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

After unregisterAll, isRegistered returns false.

### Actual Behavior

After registering CommandOrControl+Shift+7 and calling unregisterAll, isRegistered still returns true. The Fiddle in the field below logs the three steps in order.

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/repro-fixture/46720270000000000000000000000007

### Additional Information

Open the supplied Fiddle and click Run; no external services are involved.
